{{Quote|Your previous arrangement with the Republic was ''ten percent''!''"<br />"''Please, please! That was before deregulation. The same rules don't apply, my dear. The Separatists don't seem to mind a rate hike. In fact, they just secured a loan to fund an additional three million battle droids.|Senator Amidala and Mak Plain discuss the Banking Clan's new loan policies|<ref name="PoP" />}}
'''Mak Plain''' was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Banker/Legends|banker]] who lived during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Plain worked as an official within the Muun-run [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and represented the Clan's loan policies and practices on the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], in the aftermath of a failed [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace initiative]] to end the war and a devastating [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|terrorist attack]] on Coruscant, Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] introduced a [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|bill]] before the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Congress]] that would appropriate a loan from the InterGalactic Banking Clan to fund the addition of five million [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Senators [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]], both of whom opposed the bill, met with Plain to discuss the cost of such a loan. During the meeting, Plain revealed that in light of a recent [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|decision]] by the Senate to deregulate the banking industry, the Banking Clan's interest rate on government loans would increase from the original ten percent to a new rate of twenty-five percent. Due to Burtoni's campaigning and the fact that the Confederacy had already secured such a loan from the Banking Clan, the military enhancement bill was approved.

==Biography==
{{Dialogue|Plain|We will lend the Republic at our standard interest rate of&hellip; twenty-five percent.|Amidala|What?!|Farr|Twenty-five percent? That's outright ''theft''!|attr=Plain, Amidala, and Farr discuss the new lending arrangement|src=<ref name="PoP" />}}
Mak Plain was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the final [[Standard year/Legends|years]]<ref name="PoP" /> of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]].<ref name="Great Peace">{{CSWECite|I|363|Great Peace of the Republic}} indicates that the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] ended with the onset of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Given that Plain's adult appearance in "[[Pursuit of Peace]]" takes place in approximately [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] according to the ''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'', this article assumes that he was alive some years prior to that point, and therefore during the latter end of the Great Peace of the Republic.</ref> Like many other members of his [[Species/Legends|species]], Plain worked as a [[Banker/Legends|banker]] for the Muun-run [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]<ref name="PoP" />&mdash;[[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] largest and most [[Politics/Legends|politically]] powerful financial institution.<ref name="Aliens">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the dominant government of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the breakaway [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Plain served the Banking Clan as a loan [[Officer/Legends|officer]] and executive representative on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. There, the Muun worked out of his [[Mak Plain's office/Legends|office]] and negotiated government loan settlements with Republic leaders.<ref name="PoP" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the Republic debated a [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|bill]] that would deregulate the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy's]] financial institutions so that the government could secure larger loans to further fund the war effort. The legislation, which was partially sponsored by Banking Clan lobbyist [[Nix Card/Legends|Nix Card]], passed with an overwhelming majority following a Confederate [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|terrorist attack]] on Coruscant's [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|power generators]] and the failure of a fledgling [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace movement]].<ref name="Heroes">{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>

[[File:MakPlainsOffice-PursuitOfPeace.png|thumb|left|300px|Mak Plain meets with Senators Amidala and Farr.]]
Immediately after the passage of the deregulation bill, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] drafted and introduced a [[Republic military enhancement bill/Legends|bill]] that would secure a loan from the InterGalactic Banking Clan to fund the [[Cloning/Legends|growth]] and training of five million new [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. Unbeknownst to many senators, given the recent implementation of lender deregulation, Plain and the Banking Clan would be able to offer the loan with a twenty-five percent interest rate&mdash;a dramatic hike from the previous government rate of ten percent. While the debate over the bill raged on Coruscant, the Confederacy, to which the Banking Clan also lent, accepted the new interest rate and secured their own loan to finance the creation of three million more [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] units.<ref name="PoP" />

Two senators opposed to the Republic appropriations bill&mdash;[[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]&mdash;met with Plain to investigate the Banking Clan's new loan policies and the details of the proposed loan. To the senators' shock and disgust, Plain divulged that the loan would carry a twenty-five percent interest rate. The Muun tried to temper their revulsion by revealing that the Confederacy had no problem paying at the new rate, but Amidala only questioned Plain's motives for allowing the Confederacy to acquire more forces. Although Plain made his home on the Republic capital, he assured the Senator that the Banking Clan had no stake or bias in the war between the Republic and Confederacy. Shortly after his meeting with Amidala and Farr, Plain met with Burtoni in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]]. Despite an impassioned plea to reject the appropriations bill from Amidala to the Senate [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later,<ref name="PoP" /> the legislation passed,<ref name="HolocronKeeper">{{Twitter|HolocronKeeper|status/10941008766308352|[[Leland Chee]]|date=2010-12-03|quote=For those left wondering, we learned in Season 2 Senate Murders that the military spending increase passed anyway.|nolive=1}}</ref> and the Republic secured the loan.<ref name="PoP" /> Although Amidala continued her quest to [[Reduced military spending bill/Legends|repeal]] the bill and cancel the loan, Burtoni's legislation stood and the order for the clone troopers went forward.<ref name="Senate Murders">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We have no stake in this war, Senator. You know that. War is&hellip; distasteful to all of us.|Mak Plain, to Padmé Amidala|<ref name="PoP" />}}
A Muun, Mak Plain was exceedingly tall for a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]], easily towering over the [[Human/Legends|Human]] Padmé Amidala and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] Onaconda Farr,<ref name="PoP" /> who stood at 1.65 and 1.73 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], respectively.<ref name="SWE-Padmé Amidala">{{SWE|characters|padmeamidala|Padmé Amidala}}</ref><ref name="SWE-Onaconda Farr">{{SWE|characters|onacondafarr|Onaconda Farr}}</ref> He spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] with a nasally inflection, and, as was typical of Muuns, he was fair-skinned and lacked head or facial [[Hair/Legends|hair]]. His [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] were yellow in [[Color/Legends|color]]. During his meeting with Senators Amidala and Farr, he garbed himself in a tight-fitting red [[shirt]] underneath a dark vest and floor-length skirt, and crowned his tall head with a banded headdress.<ref name="PoP" />

Plain was typical of many Muuns&mdash;greatly concerned with financial affairs and eager to reap great profit on behalf of the InterGalactic Banking Clan.<ref name="Aliens" /> Although he lived and worked on the Republic capital planet, Plain had no qualms about operating with both the age-old democracy and its opposition, the upstart Confederate movement. This political apathy was widespread in the Banking Clan management and practiced by other Coruscant-based officials,<ref name="PoP" /> such as Senator [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]]<ref name="Spy">{{TCW|Senate Spy}}</ref> and lobbyist Nix Card.<ref name="Heroes" /> When the Muun was visited by Amidala and Farr, he gladly informed them of the Banking Clan's drastic rate hike and used the threat of new Separatist war matériel to convince them of the Republic's need for a new loan. After Amidala questioned his loyalty to the Republic, Plain claimed that he and the Clan had no stake in the war&mdash;a thinly veiled lie to hide the reality of the profitability of further conflict and [[Blood/Legends|bloodshed]].<ref name="PoP" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MakPlainZygerria-SOTR.png|thumb|right|250px|One of the many "Mak Plains" on Zygerria]]
Mak Plain was introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the eleventh episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]]. The episode, titled "[[Pursuit of Peace]]," first aired on [[December 3]] of [[2010]] and featured the voice talents of [[Stephen Stanton]] in the role of Mak Plain.<ref name="PoP" /> On [[December 2]], [[2011]], the twelfth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|Season Four]] of ''The Clone Wars'', titled "[[Slaves of the Republic]]," featured a number of Muun background characters on the Confederate-allied [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], outside the [[Royal Palace of Zygerria/Legends|Zygerrian Royal Palace]] in a [[Zygerrian slave market/Legends|slave market]]. At least two of these Muuns were identical to Plain's appearance in "Pursuit of Peace," but due to the fact that there were multiple instances of the character model being utilized in the same scene,<ref name="Slaves">{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}}</ref> Plain's presence in the episode is uncertain, and has not yet been confirmed by official sources.
